list.label: Domain controller
list.query:
SELECT DISTINCT h.DisplayName AS __text, h.DisplayName AS __value
FROM dbo.vManagedEntity e
JOIN dbo.vManagedEntityType t ON t.ManagedEntityTypeRowId = e.ManagedEntityTypeRowId
JOIN dbo.vManagedEntity h ON h.ManagedEntityRowId = e.TopLevelHostManagedEntityRowId
WHERE t.ManagedEntityTypeSystemName LIKE 'Microsoft.Windows.Server.%AD%DomainControllerRole'
ORDER BY 1

list.name: dc

description: Health, alerts, replication and LDAP load for one domain controller.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT TOP 200
  g.Path AS DC,
  CASE g.HealthState WHEN 1 THEN 'Healthy' WHEN 2 THEN 'Warning' WHEN 3 THEN 'Critical' ELSE 'Not monitored' END AS Health,
  g.StateLastModified AS LastStateChange,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT al.AlertId AS Id, al.AlertName AS Name, al.AlertDescription AS Description, al.BaseManagedEntityId AS MonitoringObjectId, bm.DisplayName AS MonitoringObjectDisplayName, bm.FullName AS MonitoringObjectFullName, bm.Path AS MonitoringObjectPath, bm.TopLevelHostEntityId AS TopLevelHostEntityId, al.IsMonitorAlert, al.RuleId AS MonitoringRuleId, al.ResolutionState, al.Priority, al.Severity, al.Category, al.Owner, al.ResolvedBy, al.TimeRaised, al.LastModified, al.TimeResolved, al.RepeatCount, al.TicketId, al.Context, al.AlertParams, al.CustomField1, al.CustomField2, al.CustomField3, (SELECT TOP 1 lt.LTValue FROM dbo.LocalizedText lt WHERE lt.LTStringId = al.AlertStringId AND lt.LTStringType = 1 ORDER BY CASE WHEN lt.LanguageCode = 'ENU' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, lt.LanguageCode) AS AlertStringName, (SELECT TOP 1 lt.LTValue FROM dbo.LocalizedText lt WHERE lt.LTStringId = al.AlertStringId AND lt.LTStringType = 2 ORDER BY CASE WHEN lt.LanguageCode = 'ENU' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, lt.LanguageCode) AS AlertStringDescription FROM dbo.Alert al JOIN dbo.BaseManagedEntity bm ON bm.BaseManagedEntityId = al.BaseManagedEntityId) a WHERE a.ResolutionState < 255
     AND a.TopLevelHostEntityId IN (SELECT c.Id FROM dbo.ManagedEntityGenericView c WHERE c.DisplayName = g.Path)) AS OpenAlerts
FROM dbo.ManagedEntityGenericView g
WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.ManagedTypeView t WHERE t.Id = g.MonitoringClassId AND t.Name LIKE 'Microsoft.Windows.Server.%AD%DomainControllerRole') AND g.IsDeleted = 0
  AND g.Path IN (${dc:singlequote})
ORDER BY CASE g.HealthState WHEN 3 THEN 0 WHEN 2 THEN 1 WHEN 1 THEN 3 ELSE 2 END, g.Path

WITH x AS (
  SELECT h.DisplayName AS dc, r.ObjectName AS o, r.CounterName AS c, p.SampleValue AS v, p.DateTime AS t,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY h.DisplayName, r.ObjectName, r.CounterName, i.InstanceName ORDER BY p.DateTime DESC) AS rn
  FROM Perf.vPerfRaw p
  JOIN dbo.vPerformanceRuleInstance i ON i.PerformanceRuleInstanceRowId = p.PerformanceRuleInstanceRowId
  JOIN dbo.vPerformanceRule r ON r.RuleRowId = i.RuleRowId
  JOIN dbo.vManagedEntity e ON e.ManagedEntityRowId = p.ManagedEntityRowId
  JOIN dbo.vManagedEntity h ON h.ManagedEntityRowId = e.TopLevelHostManagedEntityRowId
  WHERE p.DateTime > DATEADD(hour, -3, GETUTCDATE())
    AND h.DisplayName IN (${dc:singlequote})
    AND ( (r.ObjectName = 'DirectoryServices' AND r.CounterName IN ('LDAP Client Sessions', 'LDAP Searches/sec'))
       OR (r.ObjectName = 'AD Replication' AND r.CounterName = 'AD Replication Queue')
       OR (r.ObjectName = 'AD RID Pool' AND r.CounterName = '% Free')
       OR (r.ObjectName = 'General Response' AND r.CounterName IN ('Active Directory Last Bind', 'Global Catalog Search Time'))
       OR (r.ObjectName = 'AD Storage' AND r.CounterName IN ('Database Size', 'Database Drive Free Space')) )
)
SELECT dc AS DC,
  MAX(CASE WHEN c = 'LDAP Client Sessions' THEN v END) AS "LDAP sessions",
  MAX(CASE WHEN c = 'LDAP Searches/sec' THEN v END) AS "LDAP searches/s",
  MAX(CASE WHEN c = 'AD Replication Queue' THEN v END) AS "Replication queue",
  MAX(CASE WHEN c = '% Free' THEN v END) AS "RID pool free %",
  MAX(CASE WHEN c = 'Active Directory Last Bind' THEN v END) AS "Last bind (ms)",
  MAX(CASE WHEN c = 'Global Catalog Search Time' THEN v END) AS "GC search (ms)",
  MAX(CASE WHEN c = 'Database Size' THEN v END) / 1048576.0 AS "Database (MB)",
  MAX(CASE WHEN c = 'Database Drive Free Space' THEN v END) / 1073741824.0 AS "DB drive free (GB)",
  MAX(t) AS "Latest sample (UTC)"
FROM x WHERE rn = 1 GROUP BY dc ORDER BY dc

SELECT DISTINCT TOP 300
  CASE s.HealthState WHEN 3 THEN 'Critical' ELSE 'Warning' END AS Health,
  COALESCE((SELECT TOP 1 m.DisplayName FROM dbo.MonitorView m WHERE m.Id = s.MonitorId AND m.DisplayName IS NOT NULL ORDER BY CASE WHEN m.LanguageCode = 'ENU' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, m.LanguageCode), s.MonitorName) AS Monitor,
  e.DisplayName AS Object,
  LEFT(COALESCE(e.Path, e.DisplayName), CHARINDEX(';', COALESCE(e.Path, e.DisplayName) + ';') - 1) AS DC,
  s.LastModified AS Since
FROM dbo.StateView s
JOIN dbo.ManagedEntityGenericView e ON e.Id = s.BaseManagedEntityId
WHERE s.HealthState IN (2, 3)
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.MonitorView m WHERE m.Id = s.MonitorId AND m.IsUnitMonitor = 1)
  AND e.IsDeleted = 0
  AND LEFT(COALESCE(e.Path, e.DisplayName), CHARINDEX(';', COALESCE(e.Path, e.DisplayName) + ';') - 1) IN (${dc:singlequote})
ORDER BY 1 DESC, 5 DESC

SELECT TOP 300
  CASE a.Severity WHEN 2 THEN 'Critical' WHEN 1 THEN 'Warning' ELSE 'Information' END AS Severity,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(a.AlertStringName, ''), a.Name) AS Alert,
  CAST(a.Id AS varchar(36)) AS AlertId,
  a.MonitoringObjectDisplayName AS Source,
  (SELECT TOP 1 c.DisplayName FROM dbo.ManagedEntityGenericView c WHERE c.Id = a.TopLevelHostEntityId) AS DC,
  a.RepeatCount AS Repeats,
  a.TimeRaised AS Raised
FROM (SELECT al.AlertId AS Id, al.AlertName AS Name, al.AlertDescription AS Description, al.BaseManagedEntityId AS MonitoringObjectId, bm.DisplayName AS MonitoringObjectDisplayName, bm.FullName AS MonitoringObjectFullName, bm.Path AS MonitoringObjectPath, bm.TopLevelHostEntityId AS TopLevelHostEntityId, al.IsMonitorAlert, al.RuleId AS MonitoringRuleId, al.ResolutionState, al.Priority, al.Severity, al.Category, al.Owner, al.ResolvedBy, al.TimeRaised, al.LastModified, al.TimeResolved, al.RepeatCount, al.TicketId, al.Context, al.AlertParams, al.CustomField1, al.CustomField2, al.CustomField3, (SELECT TOP 1 lt.LTValue FROM dbo.LocalizedText lt WHERE lt.LTStringId = al.AlertStringId AND lt.LTStringType = 1 ORDER BY CASE WHEN lt.LanguageCode = 'ENU' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, lt.LanguageCode) AS AlertStringName, (SELECT TOP 1 lt.LTValue FROM dbo.LocalizedText lt WHERE lt.LTStringId = al.AlertStringId AND lt.LTStringType = 2 ORDER BY CASE WHEN lt.LanguageCode = 'ENU' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, lt.LanguageCode) AS AlertStringDescription FROM dbo.Alert al JOIN dbo.BaseManagedEntity bm ON bm.BaseManagedEntityId = al.BaseManagedEntityId) a
WHERE a.ResolutionState < 255
  AND a.TimeRaised BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
  AND a.TopLevelHostEntityId IN (SELECT c.Id FROM dbo.ManagedEntityGenericView c WHERE c.DisplayName IN (${dc:singlequote}))
ORDER BY a.Severity DESC, a.TimeRaised DESC

SELECT time, metric, value FROM (
  SELECT DATEADD(minute, (DATEDIFF(minute, 0, p.DateTime) / 5) * 5, 0) AS time,
         h.DisplayName + CASE WHEN i.InstanceName IN ('', '_Total', 'NTDS') THEN '' ELSE ' [' + i.InstanceName + ']' END AS metric,
         AVG(p.SampleValue) * 1 AS value
  FROM Perf.vPerfRaw p
  JOIN dbo.vPerformanceRuleInstance i ON i.PerformanceRuleInstanceRowId = p.PerformanceRuleInstanceRowId
  JOIN dbo.vPerformanceRule r ON r.RuleRowId = i.RuleRowId
  JOIN dbo.vManagedEntity e ON e.ManagedEntityRowId = p.ManagedEntityRowId
  JOIN dbo.vManagedEntity h ON h.ManagedEntityRowId = e.TopLevelHostManagedEntityRowId
  WHERE DATEDIFF(minute, $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) <= 2880
    AND p.DateTime BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
    AND r.ObjectName = 'DirectoryServices' AND r.CounterName = 'LDAP Client Sessions'
    AND (i.InstanceName IN ('_Total', '', 'NTDS') OR '*' = '*')
    AND h.DisplayName IN (${dc:singlequote})
  GROUP BY DATEADD(minute, (DATEDIFF(minute, 0, p.DateTime) / 5) * 5, 0), h.DisplayName, i.InstanceName
  UNION ALL
  SELECT p.DateTime,
         h.DisplayName + CASE WHEN i.InstanceName IN ('', '_Total', 'NTDS') THEN '' ELSE ' [' + i.InstanceName + ']' END,
         AVG(p.AverageValue) * 1
  FROM Perf.vPerfHourly p
  JOIN dbo.vPerformanceRuleInstance i ON i.PerformanceRuleInstanceRowId = p.PerformanceRuleInstanceRowId
  JOIN dbo.vPerformanceRule r ON r.RuleRowId = i.RuleRowId
  JOIN dbo.vManagedEntity e ON e.ManagedEntityRowId = p.ManagedEntityRowId
  JOIN dbo.vManagedEntity h ON h.ManagedEntityRowId = e.TopLevelHostManagedEntityRowId
  WHERE DATEDIFF(minute, $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) > 2880
    AND p.DateTime BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
    AND r.ObjectName = 'DirectoryServices' AND r.CounterName = 'LDAP Client Sessions'
    AND (i.InstanceName IN ('_Total', '', 'NTDS') OR '*' = '*')
    AND h.DisplayName IN (${dc:singlequote})
  GROUP BY p.DateTime, h.DisplayName, i.InstanceName
) x ORDER BY time

SELECT time, metric, value FROM (
  SELECT DATEADD(minute, (DATEDIFF(minute, 0, p.DateTime) / 5) * 5, 0) AS time,
         h.DisplayName + CASE WHEN i.InstanceName IN ('', '_Total', 'NTDS') THEN '' ELSE ' [' + i.InstanceName + ']' END AS metric,
         AVG(p.SampleValue) * 1 AS value
  FROM Perf.vPerfRaw p
  JOIN dbo.vPerformanceRuleInstance i ON i.PerformanceRuleInstanceRowId = p.PerformanceRuleInstanceRowId
  JOIN dbo.vPerformanceRule r ON r.RuleRowId = i.RuleRowId
  JOIN dbo.vManagedEntity e ON e.ManagedEntityRowId = p.ManagedEntityRowId
  JOIN dbo.vManagedEntity h ON h.ManagedEntityRowId = e.TopLevelHostManagedEntityRowId
  WHERE DATEDIFF(minute, $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) <= 2880
    AND p.DateTime BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
    AND r.ObjectName = 'General Response' AND r.CounterName = 'Global Catalog Search Time'
    AND (i.InstanceName IN ('_Total', '', 'NTDS') OR '*' = '*')
    AND h.DisplayName IN (${dc:singlequote})
  GROUP BY DATEADD(minute, (DATEDIFF(minute, 0, p.DateTime) / 5) * 5, 0), h.DisplayName, i.InstanceName
  UNION ALL
  SELECT p.DateTime,
         h.DisplayName + CASE WHEN i.InstanceName IN ('', '_Total', 'NTDS') THEN '' ELSE ' [' + i.InstanceName + ']' END,
         AVG(p.AverageValue) * 1
  FROM Perf.vPerfHourly p
  JOIN dbo.vPerformanceRuleInstance i ON i.PerformanceRuleInstanceRowId = p.PerformanceRuleInstanceRowId
  JOIN dbo.vPerformanceRule r ON r.RuleRowId = i.RuleRowId
  JOIN dbo.vManagedEntity e ON e.ManagedEntityRowId = p.ManagedEntityRowId
  JOIN dbo.vManagedEntity h ON h.ManagedEntityRowId = e.TopLevelHostManagedEntityRowId
  WHERE DATEDIFF(minute, $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) > 2880
    AND p.DateTime BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
    AND r.ObjectName = 'General Response' AND r.CounterName = 'Global Catalog Search Time'
    AND (i.InstanceName IN ('_Total', '', 'NTDS') OR '*' = '*')
    AND h.DisplayName IN (${dc:singlequote})
  GROUP BY p.DateTime, h.DisplayName, i.InstanceName
) x ORDER BY time

WITH x AS (
  SELECT h.DisplayName AS dc, r.ObjectName AS role, r.CounterName AS c, p.SampleValue AS v, p.DateTime AS t,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY h.DisplayName, r.ObjectName, r.CounterName ORDER BY p.DateTime DESC) AS rn
  FROM Perf.vPerfRaw p
  JOIN dbo.vPerformanceRuleInstance i ON i.PerformanceRuleInstanceRowId = p.PerformanceRuleInstanceRowId
  JOIN dbo.vPerformanceRule r ON r.RuleRowId = i.RuleRowId
  JOIN dbo.vManagedEntity e ON e.ManagedEntityRowId = p.ManagedEntityRowId
  JOIN dbo.vManagedEntity h ON h.ManagedEntityRowId = e.TopLevelHostManagedEntityRowId
  WHERE p.DateTime > DATEADD(hour, -3, GETUTCDATE()) AND r.ObjectName LIKE '% Op Master'
    AND h.DisplayName IN (${dc:singlequote})
)
SELECT dc AS DC, REPLACE(role, ' Op Master', '') AS "Role",
  MAX(CASE WHEN c LIKE '%Last Bind' THEN v END) AS "Bind (raw)",
  MAX(CASE WHEN c LIKE '%Last Ping' THEN v END) AS "Ping (raw)",
  MAX(t) AS "Latest sample (UTC)"
FROM x WHERE rn = 1 GROUP BY dc, role ORDER BY dc, role
